prompt: Which are sound release practices for a published action? Choose all that apply.
explanation: Tags are the consumer-facing contract: exact releases to pin to, a moving major for automatic fixes, SHAs when reproducibility is non-negotiable. Deleting tags or shipping only to a branch leaves consumers with no stable reference at all.

options.text: Tag each release so consumers can reference a stable point
Deleting a published tag silently upgrades consumers to the newest code
Maintain a moving major tag, like `v2`, alongside patch and minor tags
Let consumers pin to a full commit SHA when they need exact reproducibility
Push releases only to the default branch, never as tags
